text: Which account was the lamp delivery at door 6, Pellow or Pellucid? Kwame and I went round on this in February.
reply_text:
Sofia, it was Pellow (Pellow Home Living). On 17 Feb in this channel, you and Kwame settled it. The lamp delivery at door 6 sits on your retail account, which is Pellow, the Mid-Atlantic home goods appointments. The Gulf Coast terminal rows, including the container pickup, are Pellucid Harbor Logistics.

The "PHL" filter returns both accounts, which is probably how the mix-up started.
